stats.body: Abu Dhabi Cycling Club unites riders of all levels with community rides and training programs.

mission.intro: At Abu Dhabi Cycling Club, our mission is to inspire riders, develop athletes, and build a thriving cycling culture across the emirate.
mission.heading: 01. Our Mission
mission.body: To promote cycling as a healthy lifestyle and competitive sport by creating opportunities for riders to train, participate in events, and connect with the cycling community across Abu Dhabi.
mission.visionBody: To become the leading cycling club in the UAE, known for excellence, inclusivity, and producing championship-level athletes who represent Abu Dhabi on the world stage.

community.title: Community
community.text: Cycling unites people. Our rides and events welcome riders of all levels.

excellence.title: Excellence
excellence.text: We help cyclists enhance endurance, speed, and performance.

inclusivity.title: Inclusivity
inclusivity.text: Cycling is a lifestyle that inspires dedication and love for the ride.

achievement.title: Achievement
achievement.text: We promote cycling as a healthy activity that encourages active lifestyles.

intro.body: Explore races, community rides, and challenges by Abu Dhabi Cycling Club. Find events for your location and skill.

From scenic coastal rides to high-performance cycling circuits, Abu Dhabi offers world-class tracks designed for every rider. Whether you're training for endurance, improving speed, or enjoying a casual ride, discover routes that match your level and ambition.

infrastructure.title: Top Infrastructure
infrastructure.desc: Ride on well-designed cycling tracks with smooth surfaces and clear markings.

routes.title: Curated Routes
routes.desc: Discover hand-picked routes for every skill level across Abu Dhabi.

community.title: Community Rides
community.desc: Join group rides and connect with fellow cyclists on every route.

performance.title: Performance Tracking
performance.desc: Log rides and monitor your progress with the ADCC app.

intro.body: Abu Dhabi Cycling Club provides exciting opportunities for endurance rides and competitive challenges. Whether chasing distance, speed, or competing, our challenges keep you motivated.
Join groups of riders who share your passion. From training clubs to social rides, find your place in the ADCC community.

intro.title: We're Here to Help You Ride Better
intro.body: Have a question about membership, events, or training? Reach out and our team will get back to you.
